_comment: Two products whose ids are ONE character long, laid over store.json by a case
A real connected shop numbers its products 1, 2, 3... and SELL once could not
see a citation shorter than three characters: a correct recommendation of
product 4 had its description withheld from verify and was handed to a person
(CONNECTING_A_NEW_SHOP_LOG.md G36). Every id in store.json is long, which is
why no case caught it. The one fact the case relies on - safe on a camp stove -
is in product 4's description and nowhere else.
